reason: The cited evidence (E1, E3) shows that a liquid precursor method synthesizes single-phase high-entropy diborides at 1800 °C with ultrafine grains, but it is for multi-cation systems, not single-phase ZrB2. The claim that lower temperature reduces microporosity and improves plating resistance is not directly supported by the cited passages, which focus on powder synthesis and do not discuss porosity, mechanical integrity, or service performance.
premises: Liquid precursor method can synthesize single-phase ZrB2 at ~1800 °C
Liquid precursor method yields ultrafine, uniformly distributed grains
Lower synthesis temperature reduces microporosity and processing defects
